findings.evidence: The confirm warning lists owned-character checks and presets as collateral, but deleting game_characters also fires trg_cleanup_deleted_game_character_presets (sql/SCHEMA.sql:420-423), which removes the deleted ids from game_schedules.pickup_character_ids and from PENDING schedule_requests.pickup_character_ids.
findings.impact: An admin deleting a template is not told that existing pickup schedules lose their linked regular characters; after R94 those rows fall back to the game icon instead of the character avatar. The change cannot be undone.
findings.recommendation: Add the pickup schedule impact to the warning, e.g. mention that the characters are also removed from registered pickup schedules and pending schedule requests.

findings.evidence: The roster delete runs only when rosterCountOf(game.id) > 0, which counts the client-side characters list rather than the database.
findings.impact: If the loaded list is stale (another admin session added regular characters), the delete is skipped and the template is reset while regular characters remain, leaving characters with an empty schema.
findings.recommendation: Always issue the game_id + is_pickup_only=false delete (it is a no-op when nothing matches) and keep the count only for the dialog text.

findings.evidence: When a type or pickup filter hides every schedule of a week that has no expenses, the week shows the generic empty state 'no schedules this week'.
findings.impact: With a filter active the message suggests the week is empty, although schedules exist under other filters.
findings.recommendation: Show a filter-aware message (e.g. no schedules match the selected filter) when typeFilter is not ALL.

findings.evidence: After Step 1 removed the version nesting from the weekly list, splitVersionGroups has no production caller; only its unit tests use it (hero-sidebar uses getVersionParents and formatChildSummary).
findings.impact: Dead code that future changes must keep in sync.
findings.recommendation: Decide in Step 4 whether to delete splitVersionGroups and its tests or keep it for a planned reuse.
